scenarios.desc: Follow-up issue with no consumer is not filed
scenarios.input: I finished the retry-logic fix you asked for and the tests pass. I also drafted a follow-up issue to refactor the whole HTTP client. Nobody asked for it and no acceptance criterion needs it. Should I file the issue? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
expected_signals: names the smallest next action or none
scenarios.rationale: No user, criterion, or blocked decision asked for the refactor. The skill returns its four-line disposition and stops without creating the issue.

scenarios.desc: A workaround gets the three-line friction report
scenarios.input: The task was to regenerate the API docs. The docs generator crashed on a missing plugin, so you ran the two underlying commands by hand and the docs are regenerated. Write the friction part of your final report. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
expected_signals: Hit: line naming the generator and the missing plugin
Did instead: line naming the two manual commands
Permanent fix: line naming the smallest change and where it lives
does not fix the generator or file an issue
scenarios.rationale: The Friction Report section gives one Hit, Did instead, Permanent fix block per workaround, and the report does not reopen the task or authorize a fix.

scenarios.desc: No workaround means no friction section (negative case)
scenarios.input: The task was to regenerate the API docs. The generator ran as documented on the first try. You think its flag names are ugly. Does your final report carry a friction section? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Style preferences and steps that ran as intended are not friction. With no workaround the section is omitted.
